text:
ops-bot: [ALERT] tool-exec error rate >= 8% in prod-us-west-2 (5m avg). alert_id=inc-2026-3955. spike started ~5m ago.
maya: taking this. paging oncall.
jonah: grabbing flamegraphs and proxy logs now. initial glance: agent-proxy CPU and queue length both spiked at same time as errors.
maya: noted. can we confirm whether this is external action execs only or also internal functioncalls?
jonah: looks like external action execs (third-party integrations) are failing with 504/timeout from runner pool. internal calls fine.
maya: plan: 1) engage emergency rate-brake for external action/function calling for free and trial tenants (protecting paid/dedicated), 2) enable text-only fallback for affected routes, 3) start customer-impact triage and CS notify. execute canary on a single host then roll.
ellen: +1. prioritize low-cost mitigation (config toggle) so we can revert quickly. keep me posted before broad rollout.
sam (cs): I'll draft a short customer note: "temporary restriction on third-party tool invocations to reduce errors — text-only answers will still be available." Will post to status page after ops confirms.
maya: applying canary now. patching runtime config:
```sh
# canary on host-23
kubectl -n runtime patch cm runtime-config --patch '{"data": {"external_tool_rate_limit":"10rps","tool_exec_enabled":"true","text_only_fallback":"true"}}'
```
maya: canary applied to host-23. monitoring metrics.
ops-bot: config-change detected: runtime-config patched on host-23 by maya.
jonah: canary looks good after 60s: queue depth -40%, tool-exec errors down from 8.3% -> 1.4% on host-23.
maya: rolling to regional plane: applying rate limits and enable text-only fallback for free/trial plans. will exclude dedicated customers and enterprise pinned instances.
ellen: tell me when rollout reaches 50% of upstream.
maya: at 50% now. error rate region-wide down to 2.1% and latency tail improving.
sam (cs): draft ready, posting to status.redwood.ai now. message: "We are limiting third-party tool invocations briefly to reduce errors; customers on dedicated plans unaffected. We will update when full service restored"
ops-bot: status page posted.
jonah: watching for any unexpected downstream regressions — CPU normalized, no new error classes.
maya: rolling complete. full rollout done at 3955554385.
ops-bot: mitigation completed (change_id=cfg-3955-roll).
ellen: good job. next: 1) revert plan if healthy for 30m, 2) run post-incident load replay to see if capacity tuning or autoscaler rules need adjustments, 3) add circuit breaker per-tenant to avoid single tenant storms.
maya: agrees. I'll keep rate limits in place for 30m then slowly ramp if stable. scheduling postmortem for tomorrow 10:00am.
sam (cs): queued follow-up email to customers impacted with summary and expected timeline for restore.
jonah: capturing logs and artifacts (span traces, proxy dumps) for the postmortem.
ellen: closing loop here — ping me if anything worsens. otherwise we'll transition to incident review channel. :white_check_mark:
